subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a repaired replacement for this draft delivery-ordering fix, or keep the PR waiting on the contributor?
rationale: The bug and proof are strong, but the draft is dirty and the repair crosses outbound queue ownership, canonical target identity, and platform-send stall policy.

options.title: Sponsor Repair Before Merge
options.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue and platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh the Telegram proof.

options.title: Wait For Contributor
options.body: Keep the draft open but require the contributor to rebase and address the existing findings before another merge-readiness review.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue and platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh the Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The keyed queue failure semantics and cleanup history make this the strongest routing candidate from the likely-owner set.
